newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot products boosted by NYMEX, diffs steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot products boosted by NYMEX, diffs steady.

text.p: U.S. spot refined product prices rebounded higher by midday Tuesday as the NYMEX futures prices moved up.
However, little movement in the spot market differentials was noted, traders said, with activity remaining subdued.
NYMEX March gasoline was up about 1.00 cent and March heating oil was up 0.90 cent on mostly speculative short covering from the recent losses.
New York Harbor (NYH) prompt No. 2 oil may have firmed slightly, though market players said only small parcels appeared to have changed hands during early action.
NYH prompt No. 2 oil was offered at 0.50 cent over the screen, up about 0.15 cent on the day, though few buyers were interested in the higher levels.
U.S. Gulf (USG) gasoline prices also showed some slight strength during early action with conventional unleaded M3 gasoline offered at 3.00 cents under the screen, up about 0.25 cent from Monday.
USG M2 conventional unleaded for later March delivery was talked on either side of 3.25 cents under the print, traders said.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
